name: flash-sale-burst
title: Flash Sale Burst
description: A two-word headline rises in, a big percent figure bursts in and shakes once in the accent colour, two crossed running ribbons (black, and outlined) run their text in opposite directions and clear away, then the deadline is set in a bordered box. Clean white page, no starburst.
useWhen: A time-limited discount, a merch drop or a class closing soon where the percent is the headline.
The deadline must be stated as plain text so it stays true whenever the video is watched.
avoidWhen: One product with an old and a new price: use price-drop.
A live clock counting to a moment: use event-countdown-clock.
Calm, premium tone: the shake and flashes are loud.
author: Mosio
